name: max-ux-flow
description: Design a UX flow finance-first (regulated, but modern — Fireblocks-grade) and general-capable — what the user sees first, what they click, screen by screen, what each table shows, how data is structured, mobile vs desktop, and the money/approval/KYC safety layer. Twenty-framework canon (Norman, Cooper, JTBD, Nielsen, Tufte, Shneiderman, Wroblewski, Fireblocks maker-checker) into an eleven-section flow spec.
